jobs.calls: Scheduler.due(): kv reads; once per local day refresh_calendar (health + calendar)
toss_health -> prices(1 symbol) every tick (60 s cache, engine.py:269-277); settle; check_exits -> prices(positions); snapshot_equity every 10th minute
sync_data: per symbol in positions + open orders + watchlist: ensure_history + candles(10 d); settle; snapshot_equity (1 row per run)
sync_data + check_exits + agent session (~25-27 tool calls)
server cache 60 s (indicators.py); 8 Toss calls per refresh
quotes via prices(positions), 5 s quote cache

jobs.trigger: poll 5 s current market + 30 s other (Layout.tsx:77-78); agent/structure 5 s (Agent.tsx:33)

assumptions: toss_health cache is 60 s and intraday runs every 60 s, so every tick re-probes (1 prices call)
quote cache is 5 s, so each 1-min tick refetches quotes when positions exist
KR refresh job has no market-hours gate; US refresh runs only near the session
session cost uses the in-process scripted 25-tool session
